doc: A built crop field (design/planner.md, Crops): its plants as one mesh, each riding one of its wind groups' bones, its lot's cells and box, and the fire points it burns from.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height, metres (conformance).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius, metres.

fields.name: footprint
fields.doc: Which lot it stands on: small (rect6x4), medium (rect8x6), large (rect12x8).

fields.name: footprint_cells
fields.doc: The round footprint that holds it.

fields.name: footprint_radius
fields.doc: The radius its round footprint must hold, metres.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The cells it stands on, as q, r pairs relative to the cell under the origin; +z faces its road.

fields.name: lot_min
fields.doc: The lot's box, its low corner, metres.

fields.name: lot_max
fields.doc: The lot's box, its high corner, metres.

fields.name: guide_cells
fields.doc: Every lot this pipeline has, for the viewer: group, q, r triples.

fields.name: guide_tones
fields.doc: Each guide group's tone: 0 the lot it stands on, 2 the rest.

fields.name: plants
fields.doc: How many plants it holds.

fields.name: fire_points
fields.doc: Where fires burn, metres: hearths, forges, torches, braziers (lit), and points over its roof and walls that burn when it does.

fields.name: fire_configs
fields.doc: Each fire point's fire config (fire_v1_config's id).

fields.name: fire_lit
fields.doc: Each fire point: 1 always lit (a hearth, a torch), 0 only while the building burns, 2 its smoke only (a chimney or a smoke hole: the hearth's smoke without its flames).

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: Its wind groups' bones (sway), animated by house_animate_v1.

fields.name: positions
fields.doc: Vertex positions, metres.

fields.name: normals
fields.doc: Vertex normals.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: Triangle list.

fields.name: bone_a
fields.doc: First bone per vertex.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Second bone per vertex.

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b.

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA.

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides: the field as a query body (found by rays; walked through).
